description: This PHP source file defines the HomePageDao class, which provides data access methods for retrieving home page and module default page records based on user roles and modules within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system.

classes.name: HomePageDao
classes.description: Data access object for fetching HomePage and ModuleDefaultPage entities based on user roles and module parameters

methods.name: getHomePagesInPriorityOrder
methods.description: Returns a list of HomePage entities filtered and ordered by user roles and priority, with higher priority and ID first.

methods.name: getModuleDefaultPagesInPriorityOrder
methods.description: Returns a list of ModuleDefaultPage entities for a specified module and user roles, ordered by module name and priority.
